# `zip_with`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Merges the two given arrays, element-wise, into a single array using function. If one array is shorter, nulls are appended at the end to match the length of the longer array, before applying function.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
zip_with(left, right, func)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- zip_with, example 1
> SELECT zip_with(array(1, 2, 3), array('a', 'b', 'c'), (x, y) -> (y, x));
[{"y":"a","x":1},{"y":"b","x":2},{"y":"c","x":3}]
```

```sql
-- zip_with, example 2
> SELECT zip_with(array(1, 2), array(3, 4), (x, y) -> x + y);
[4,6]
```

```sql
-- zip_with, example 3
> SELECT zip_with(array('a', 'b', 'c'), array('d', 'e', 'f'), (x, y) -> concat(x, y));
["ad","be","cf"]
```
